flags: Hours are from their own website (the same on every page): open 7 days a week, lunch 11:30am-2:30pm and dinner 5pm-10pm. Their Instagram bio gives no hours; a pinned Instagram post says the lunch special is available daily 11:30am-2:30pm, which agrees.

No online ordering page of their own: the 'Online Ordering' page on their site says they offer take-out and to call the take-out line, (925) 433-5068. The red 'Order online with…' bar at the bottom of Glenn's screenshot (hakashi-3) is not part of their site when it is loaded directly; it looks like Instagram's in-app browser overlay, so order_url is null.

Only the lunch specials (8) and the happy hour food (18) have prices on their site. The appetizers, specialty rolls, hand rolls, maki, nigiri/sashimi, hot dishes, udon soups, omakase courses and desserts are listed with no prices, so they are left out. On the Seasonal Japanese Fish page a 'Today's Chef Special' Hokkaido Uni shows 20.00; it is a daily special, so it is left out too.

Happy hour is 'everyday' 11:30am-2:30pm and 5-7pm per their happy hour page ('Full Bar • Sushi • Small Plates'). Each oyster type is priced per half dozen and per dozen, so each is two items. The happy hour cocktails, beer, sake and wine are left out (alcohol).

Name: the site header, logo and title say 'Hakashi Sushi Bar & Grill'; the Instagram display name adds 'Walnut Creek'; the site footer says 'Hakashi Japanese Bar' and the About text 'Hakashi Japanese Sushi Bar & Grill'.
Address: their site writes '1385 N Main Street Suite C, Walnut Creek, CA 94596' and the Instagram bio '1385 N Main St Suite C, Walnut Creek'. Email is from their site's contact block.

Reservations are by phone only, per their 'Our Policy' page. That page also says they have no vegan or vegetarian menu but the chef can accommodate, and they can handle most allergies (shellfish, gluten), so dietary is left empty.

Their Instagram bio mentions 'Bluefin Tuna Events'; a post in Glenn's screenshot advertises 'The Bluefin Tuna Experience' on Saturday, Oct 17 2026 (tuna cutting, 15-course tasting, live DJ). The price and booking details are too small to read, so it is not included.
Their wording is kept, including typos ('miso sou' in Tendon, 'prok' in Tonkatsu, 'Dinamite'); item names are put in title case from their all-caps headings.
Logo: cut from the header of their own website (hakashi-1), which has the full mark with the 'HAKASHI Sushi Bar & Grill' wordmark on black; the Instagram profile picture has the geisha only.

price_note: Prices are from Ginza Sushi's own Toast pickup ordering page, linked from their website.
flags: Hours are null because their own sources disagree. Their website's hours list says Mon 11am-5pm, Tue-Sat 11am-9pm, Sun 12pm-9pm, with the note 'We close between 2:30-5pm Mon-Fri.' Their Toast page's ordering hours are Mon-Fri 11am-1:45pm & 5pm-8:45pm, Sat-Sun 12pm-8:45pm. Monday (the site says it closes at 5pm; Toast takes Monday dinner orders) and Saturday's opening time (11am vs 12pm) don't match. Glenn or Leon should confirm the hours with the owner.

Address: 'Suite A' and the ZIP 95124 are from their Toast page; their website also gives ZIP 95124 ('3153 Meridian Avenue, San Jose, California 95124'). 'Hacienda Gardens' appears only in Glenn's Google Maps screenshot (sushimakesuhappy-2), which was not used as a source, so it is not in the address.
Their Toast page is pickup only. Party trays take at least 60 minutes, and the page asks you to call with your pickup time.
